title: View transitions drawn by a canvas
blurb: startViewTransition() supplies the timing and a canvas draws the pictures: a WebGL shader on a canvas-scoped transition, nested scopes, one canvas for each list item, a group box as a drawing position, and one canvas for every change of an app.
question: Can a canvas use a view transition for timing only and draw the old and new states of its HTML itself?
result: Yes. A transition scoped to the canvas gives one CSS-timed clock for each named element, in 2D and in WebGL. Nesting needs view-transition-scope: all on the canvas.
